episodes.title: Alive in Tucson
episodes.summary: Chronicles the life and adventures of an average guy - and humanity's last hope - who discovers what life is like when no one is telling you what you can and cannot do. The year is 2020, and after a deadly virus has swept the planet, only one man is left on earth: Phil Miller. He used to be just an average guy who loved his family and hated his job. Now, in his RV, Phil searches the country for other survivors. He has traveled to every city, every town and every outpost in the United States, Mexico and Canada, and has found no one. As he returns to his hometown of Tucson, Phil comes to the realization that he is almost certainly the last living being on the face of the earth.

episodes.title: Raisin Balls and Wedding Bells
episodes.summary: Phil Miller continues to adjust to life as the last man on earth, while settling into his new mansion in Tucson. But his solitary existence could be upended.

episodes.title: Sweet Melissa
episodes.summary: Phil finds himself in a pickle and has to work fast in order to save human existence.

episodes.title: Dunk the Skunk
episodes.summary: Phil Miller continues to live in Tucson.

episodes.title: Some Friggin' Fat Guy
episodes.summary: A man named Todd shows up and could spoil Phil's chances with Melissa.

episodes.title: She Drives Me Crazy
episodes.summary: Phil Miller continues to live in Tucson.

episodes.title: Mooovin' In
episodes.summary: Phil finds a cow, but can't agree with the rest of the group on what to do with it. Meanwhile, Carol seizes an opportunity to move in with Phil.

episodes.title: The Do-Over
episodes.summary: Carol decides to improve Phil's painting.

episodes.title: Pranks for Nothin'
episodes.summary: Phil can't persuade the group that running off with Erica and Gail was just a prank, so he tries a different strategy to get his point across.

episodes.title: Moved to Tampa
episodes.summary: Phil's a single man after his divorce from Carol, and his romantic prospects seem to improve when Gail and Erica are now interested in him, but he still worries that other men might show up and ruin his chances.

episodes.title: The Tandyman Can
episodes.summary: The cul de sac decides to have a re-election for the President of the United States.

episodes.title: Screw the Moon
episodes.summary: Phil and Carol reconcile their differences.

episodes.title: Is There Anybody Out There?
episodes.summary: Phil and Carol leave Tucson behind and strike out on their own in a road trip across the United States.

episodes.title: The Boo
episodes.summary: Phil searches desperately for Carol after they're separated without phones or walkie-talkies.

episodes.title: Dead Man Walking
episodes.summary: Carol takes a page out of Phil's book when she tells a lie from which it is difficult for her to recover.

episodes.title: C to the T
episodes.summary: Phil/Tandy finds redemption when he saves the day.

episodes.title: Crickets
episodes.summary: The population may be small, but it's still big enough for big, dark secrets.

episodes.title: A Real Live Wire
episodes.summary: Tandy and Todd attempt to solve an end-of-the-world power problem.

episodes.title: Baby Steps
episodes.summary: Re-population becomes a hot topic with the Malibu survivors.

episodes.title: No Bull
episodes.summary: Phil 2 finds himself on Tandy's level when he causes problems with the group.

episodes.title: Secret Santa
episodes.summary: Along with most human life, the virus wiped out normal traditions and holidays. As Christmas approaches, Carol spearheads a "Secret Santa" gift exchange to spread some festive cheer.

episodes.title: Silent Night
episodes.summary: The pressure is on as Gail tries to fix a bad situation, and Melissa and Todd try to recover from their relationship troubles.

episodes.title: Pitch Black
episodes.summary: Mike Miller's space capsule careens through the sky toward Earth, finally putting him on the same planet as his big brother, Phil/Tandy (Will Forte). Mike thinks he is the last man on earth, but who knows what or whom he might encounter.

episodes.title: Valhalla
episodes.summary: The Malibu gang seeks closure after Phil 2's demise, while Todd and Melissa maneuver through the aftermath of her surprise proposal.

episodes.title: Fish in the Dish
episodes.summary: Carol is back on the campaign for repopulation with Phil, and Todd's juggling act finally puts him over the edge.

episodes.title: Skidmark
episodes.summary: Tandy tries to host a party for the group and Todd's luck takes a turn for the better.

episodes.title: Fourth Finger
episodes.summary: With little else to do, Tandy starts a prank war within the group. Meanwhile Todd establishes his dominance.

episodes.title: Falling Slowly
episodes.summary: Todd has a lot to think about when Tandy and Carol ask a major favor of him. Meanwhile, Gail's wine consumption has become an issue.

episodes.title: Smart and Stupid
episodes.summary: Todd feels left out, as Tandy warms to having his big brother back on Earth. Meanwhile, Mike learns more about Erica than the group has ever uncovered about her.

episodes.title: 30 Years of Science Down the Tubes
episodes.summary: Phil and Mike grow closer than ever and the whole Malibu group gets a big friggin' surprise.

episodes.title: General Breast Theme with Cobras
episodes.summary: The safety of Tandy and the group is in jeopardy as armed intruders storm the Malibu beach near their home, and no one can agree on what to do. While Melissa takes drastic action, Tandy gets a new lesson in fashion.

episodes.title: The Wild Guess Express
episodes.summary: When Todd suffers from major remorse over recent actions, Tandy tries to lift his best friend's spirits – even if it requires a few white lies.

episodes.title: You're All Going to Diet
episodes.summary: Tandy sets up a unique alarm system in the house, but Melissa has already put her own safety precautions in place. The whole group decides to enjoy a change in scenery.

episodes.title: Five Hoda Kotbs
episodes.summary: A post-apocalyptic road trip has everyone at war with each other and Gail is really pushed to her breaking point.

episodes.title: The Power of Power
episodes.summary: The group continues to search for a new place to live, but someone may be sabotaging their progress. Meanwhile, the love triangle between Todd, Gail and Melissa hits new road blocks.

episodes.title: The Open-Ended Nature of Unwitnessed Deaths
episodes.summary: Tandy attempts to develop his new friendship with Lewis by learning about his past. Meanwhile, Carol asks Gail for a big favor and Todd addresses Melissa's mental state head-on.

episodes.title: Mama's Hideaway
episodes.summary: Carol is hell-bent on capturing the perfect family photo and will stop at nothing to get it. Meanwhile, Melissa has a surprising mission of her own, Lewis looks into a new hobby and Gail finds herself stuck in a scary situation.

episodes.title: Whitney Houston, We Have a Problem
episodes.summary: After finding a mysterious note left by Melissa that says "Goodbye," the gang sets off to go look for her. Meanwhile, Gail gets stuck on a solo adventure of her own.

episodes.title: If You're Happy and You Know It
episodes.summary: Carol is bummed about Gail's absence, so Tandy tries to cheer her up with the honeymoon vacation they never had. Meanwhile, Lewis finds new success with his pursuits in aviation and Melissa is contained.

episodes.title: Got Milk?
episodes.summary: The first moments of the deadly virus outbreak are revealed through a special lens.

episodes.title: The Spirit of St. Lewis
episodes.summary: After being locked up for her own safety, Melissa plays hurtful mind games with the group. Meanwhile, Todd and the group explore medications that might help her, and Lewis goes on a new solo adventure.

episodes.title: Hair of the Dog
episodes.summary: Todd and Tandy dig deep into Melissa's pre-virus past, as they search for answers about her illness, and Carol adopts a new outlook on life.

episodes.title: Find This Thing We Need To
episodes.summary: Carol makes a big discovery, enlisting Tandy and Erica to help her track down some answers. Meanwhile, Todd has a major breakthrough with Melissa.

episodes.title: Point Person Knows Best
episodes.summary: Tandy tries to take charge of a new situation that has unfolded in the group, and Carol is suspicious of Todd's behavior.

episodes.title: Name 20 Picnics... Now!
episodes.summary: The gang throws a huge celebration canvassing every major holiday, but Tandy and Todd's bro-mance hits a rough patch that threatens to end the fun.

episodes.title: The Big Day
episodes.summary: Tandy and Gail face off in a major disagreement, on which the whole group must weigh in, and Carol is forced to choose a side. Meanwhile, Melissa, Todd and Erica each have major milestone moments.

episodes.title: When the Going Gets Tough
episodes.summary: The long term consequences of surviving an apocalypse start to have a major impact on the group, whose daily life is upended.

episodes.title: Nature's Horchata
episodes.summary: The long term consequences of surviving an apocalypse start to have a major impact on the group.

episodes.title: M.U.B.A.R.
episodes.summary: Pamela finds her place within the group as they all set sail for Mexico, avoiding the apocalyptic nuclear fallout in the United States. Their course derails a bit when they realize that none of them knows how to actually navigate a yacht.

episodes.title: Stocko Syndrome
episodes.summary: Tandy devises an escape plan to get away from Pamela and back to Carol and the others. Meanwhile, the rest of the gang encounters a castaway, Glenn, who has been stranded on an island for years.

episodes.title: Skeleton Crew
episodes.summary: Pamela tries desperately to redeem herself with everyone, as the gang finally reaches Mexico. Meanwhile, Todd is disappointed that Zihuatanejo is not the paradise of which he'd dreamed.

episodes.title: Wisconsin
episodes.summary: Carol panics when Todd and Melissa leave for their honeymoon and Erica and Gail decide to live on their own for a while. She and Tandy devise the ultimate plan to convince everyone it's safer to stick together.

episodes.title: La Abuela
episodes.summary: The gang settles into an old mansion previously owned by an infamous cartel leader. While Carol forces Tandy to put down his new toys so they can baby-proof the giant estate, Melissa worries about Todd's physical health and Gail and Erica can't figure out why Dawn won't stop crying.

episodes.title: Double Cheeseburger
episodes.summary: Carol's pregnancy takes an unexpected turn, and while Tandy feels ready to face the challenge head on, Gail is concerned and wants to intervene. Meanwhile, Melissa discourages Todd's baby fever.

episodes.title: Gender Friender
episodes.summary: Tandy goes to great lengths to convince everyone he's a feminist. Meanwhile, Carol gets jealous of the time that Gail spends with Erica and Dawn, and Todd tries to be a father figure to Jasper.

episodes.title: Not Appropriate for Miners
episodes.summary: Todd asks Tandy for parenting advice when he notices that Jasper is acting more reckless than usual. Meanwhile, Carol and Erica realize that Jasper may be the only potential suitor for their babies and begin vying for his attention.

episodes.title: Karl
episodes.summary: Tandy and Todd stumble upon a new survivor, Karl, who has been trapped in a high-security prison in Mexico ever since the virus hit.

episodes.title: Paint Misbehavin'
episodes.summary: Tandy and Todd introduce newcomer Karl (guest star Fred Armisen) to the rest of the gang. Meanwhile, the group searches for Jasper, who has gone missing.

episodes.title: Hamilton / Berg
episodes.summary: After the graveyard incident, Tandy and Todd try to convince the rest of the gang that something is majorly wrong with Karl and something needs to be done. Meanwhile, Jasper is still missing.

episodes.title: Señor Clean
episodes.summary: Tandy tries being a helpful, responsible adult in order to finally win Gail's praise. Meanwhile, Todd is furious with Melissa for keeping him away from Jasper.

episodes.title: Release the Hounds
episodes.summary: Todd sinks into a deep depression, leaving the rest of the gang to console him. Meanwhile, Tandy and Carol can't keep their hands off each other.

episodes.title: Special Delivery
episodes.summary: While Todd butts heads with Erica, Melissa is determined to form a strong female friendship with her. Meanwhile, Carol grows suspicious that a new stranger could be living nearby.

episodes.title: Designated Survivors
episodes.summary: Tandy wakes up to a shocking discovery that is positive for everyone in the group, but it throws Todd into a spiral. Meanwhile, Todd and Erica share an emotional roller coaster.

episodes.title: The Blob
episodes.summary: A thermal heat detector reveals a potential sign of life outside of the Zihuatanejo village, but Tandy doesn't want the group to split up to go investigate. Meanwhile, Todd and Erica have trouble seeing eye-to-eye.

episodes.title: Barbara Ann
episodes.summary: The gang ventures out in search of what they think could be a new sign of life, but are surprised at what they actually find. Meanwhile, Todd makes a few morbid discoveries of his own back at the mansion.

episodes.title: Cancun, Baby!
episodes.summary: After discovering hidden dangers in their mansion, the group decides to part ways with their home in Zihuatanejo and embark on a new destination. However, Tandy has second thoughts about what they may be leaving behind.
